prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve, precise-object-edit.
Edit Image 1, Ouran's portrait, with one targeted refinement of framing, expression and pixel clusters. Image 2 locks his identity. Images 3 and 4 show required mature small-grid facial planes and narrow-eye style.
Keep the same man in his forties, gray-brown tousled short hair and connected short moustache/beard, mature nose and cheekbones, visible ear, the same three-quarter orientation and gray outerwear with brown inner collar. Do not change the man or make him old.

Make these corrections to Image 1:
1. Reduce the overly tall puffy hair crown and ENLARGE the middle face and jaw. Face begins around logical y=16 and beard ends around y=88; supporting neck only 4 pixels tall, narrow clothing strip in bottom 6 pixels. The head should feel large and close, with no shoulders or chest.
2. Replace the raised central worried brow and downturned sad mouth with a cautious, attentive squint: one brow subtly LOWER, the other almost horizontal. A SHORT FLAT CLOSED MOUTH, lips gently pressed, no drooping corners. Sideways glance remains guarded and thoughtful without grief, anger or a smile.
3. Make eyes narrow and mostly dark. The sclera is just one or two tiny muted dark beige-gray pixels, dimmer than lit skin. Remove the big bright-white triangular eye blocks and all eye glints.
4. Hair in 3–4 broad irregular connected masses. Beard in 3 unified angular planes at cheeks and chin. No many parallel strips, narrow whiskers, flecks or fine texture. Keep gray-brown age cues and mature eyelids.
5. At least 2 logical pixels of TRANSPARENT margin on every side: full hair crown, ear silhouette, side hair and tiny collar visible. No touching edges or cropping hair to manufacture tight framing.

Final visual target: hard-edged 74×100 logical pixel art, large connected planes at forehead, cheeks, nose and jaw, chunky crisp pixels, at most 32 flat earthy colors, true transparent background. No gradients, blur, antialiasing, dithering, smooth high-resolution painting, text, badge lettering, hands, props, fire, keys or background. One portrait only.
